SUMMARY
**ONE BEDROOM GEORGIAN CONVERSION UPPER-GROUND FLOOR FLAT - IDEAL FOR FIRST TIME BUYERS**

The property briefly comprises of an entrance hall, OPEN PLAN LIVING/KITCHEN ROOM, bedroom & a bathroom.

DESCRIPTION
Barnard Marcus are delighted to bring to market this immaculately presented ONE BEDROOM GEORGIAN CONVERSION UPPER-GROUND FLOOR FLAT ideally situated within short distances of both PECKHAM RYE & QUEENS ROAD STATIONS which offer services in LONDON BRIDGE, VICTORIA, BLACKFRIARS, ST PANCRAS, CANADA WATER & CLAPHAM JUNCTION all in UNDER 30 MINUTES!

The property briefly comprises of an entrance hall, OPEN PLAN LIVING/KITCHEN ROOM, bedroom & a bathroom.

This property located on Peckham Hill Street, offers first-time buyers an enviable base in the heart of South East London. Commuting is seamless, with Peckham Rye Station and Queens Road Peckham Station situated a short walk away, offering Overground and National Rail services that connect to London Bridge in around ten minutes. Buyers will love the vibrant local culture right on their doorstep. The bustling hub of Rye Lane and Bellenden Road are packed with independent cafes, eclectic bars, and the famous Bussey Building. Additionally, the green open spaces of Peckham Rye Common provide a perfect weekend retreat.

Please note that an AML fee is chargeable to the buyer once an offer is accepted to cover the cost of carrying out the required identity and anti-money laundering checks. Once these checks have been completed, the fee cannot be refunded, even if the property purchase does not go ahead.
